posts.text: Databricks is Hiring! The biggest career mistake I see Senior Engineers make? Optimizing for their next title instead of their learning rate. The best engineers don't just work harder. They work on problems that force them to grow faster. Hard problems. Exceptional peers. Real ownership. That’s how learning compounds.
